mapper.select:
select comm_id, comm_div, writer, title, content, like_cnt, dislike_cnt, ( case comm_div when '1' then ( select case count(*) when 0 then 'false' else 'true' end from vote v, vote_user u where v.comm_id = c.comm_id and v.vote_id = u.vote_id and u.email_id = #{loginEmailId} ) when '2' then 'false' end ) as user_selected, ( select case count(*) when 0 then 'false' else 'true' end from community_like_user b where b.comm_id = c.comm_id and b.email_id = #{loginEmailId} and b.like_type = 'like' ) as user_liked, ( select case count(*) when 0 then 'false' else 'true' end from community_like_user b where b.comm_id = c.comm_id and b.email_id = #{loginEmailId} and b.like_type = 'dislike' ) as user_disliked from community c where 1=1
and ( writer like concat('%', #{searchText}, '%') or title like concat('%', #{searchText}, '%') )
and comm_div = #{comm_div}
and dislike_cnt <= 20
order by
save_date desc
like_cnt desc
